operational_findings: The source audit does not deploy or activate data ingestion.
Same canonical ID is used only where the researched factor definition explicitly allows the verified product; stock/ETF/continuous future identity and proxy limitations remain explicit.
BDMN.JK has 13 dates missing against installed XIDX. These may reflect unmodelled local holidays; no calendar adjustment or fabricated rows were made.
TIO=F is missing 2026-10-01. Existing strict 100% session gate will reject this window.
1343.T is missing 2025-10-24 and is not an exact factor mapping.
AGGG.L returned 379 rows initially on 2026-10-15 and 380 on recheck 2026-10-16; provider history can fill late. Final count uses recheck.
FX and several futures can return a bar beyond the requested exclusive end. All final statistics explicitly filter market dates before end; incomplete live bars are never counted.
US futures use US/XNYS only to report the existing router gate, not a claim that NYSE is their true exchange calendar. Extra sessions are retained in the audit.
FOREX uses the existing router XLON calendar; extra FX dates exist. FX volume zero is not evidence of no FX trading.
Daily historical timestamps are market labels, not proof of original public availability. First-observed timestamps and cutoff gating remain necessary.
All daily histories are a point-in-time accessibility test of the unofficial Yahoo route, with no future SLA or predictive accuracy claim.
No absent freight, VLSFO, refining spread, LME price, credit spread, low-frequency business statistic or disaster factor was replaced with generic macro or ETF data.

market_close_sources.FX: Live Yahoo chart currentTradingPeriod.regular.end and exchangeTimezoneName, retained in probe metadata. No centralized exchange close is claimed.
